summary: Changes the resolution of a TOP image with optional high-quality downsampling.

key_params.name: highqualresize
key_params.note: Use weighted averages of multiple pixels when scaling down.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Use input, scale factor, fit, limit, or custom resolution.

common_gotchas: Use Resolution TOP when an explicit resize stage is clearer than hiding resize on a Common page.
High Quality Resize is specifically for scaling down.
Fit and Limit preserve aspect ratio; Custom directly sets width and height.
Global resolution multiplier can silently change output size when enabled.
Changing aspect or pixel format can affect downstream compositing and shader assumptions.
key_concepts: Changes TOP image resolution as an explicit pipeline stage.
Most TOPs can also change resolution on the Common page, but this node makes resizing intentional in the graph.
High Quality Resize uses weighted averages when scaling down.
Fit, Limit, and Custom modes define whether aspect is preserved or exact dimensions are used.
